title: Reforge Workshop
description: Repair · Deconstruct · Enhance · Reforge – all in one GUI!
body:
# Reforge Workshop

A multi-functional reforging plugin for Paper/Spigot servers, integrating durability repair, item deconstruction, enchant enhancement, and enchant reforge into a single GUI.

## Features

- **Repair**: Restore damaged items to full durability with dynamic pricing based on lost durability
- **Deconstruct**: Revert craftable items back to raw materials with stack size support
- **Enchant Enhance**: Randomly upgrade an enchantment level with configurable success rate (default 60%)
- **Enchant Reforge**: Clear all enchantments and generate 1–3 new, non-conflicting enchantments

## How to Use

Sneak + Right-click on an Anvil to open the reforging GUI.

## Economy

- **Gold mode**: Requires Vault economy plugin
- **EXP mode**: No plugins required, works out of the box

Each feature has independent cost configuration in `config.yml`.

## Permissions

- `reforge.reload` – Allows using `/reforgereload` to reload config (default: OP)

## Multi-language

Built-in Chinese and English language packs. Switch language in `config.yml` or create your own language file!

## Compatibility

Compatible with Paper, Spigot, Purpur, and Bukkit servers from Minecraft 1.13 to 1.21+.

---

**Enjoy! 🎉**

# 重铸工坊

一个为 Paper/Spigot 服务器设计的多功能重铸插件，将耐久修复、物品分解、附魔强化和附魔重铸集成于一个界面中。

## 功能

- **修复耐久**：根据损失耐久度动态计算费用，一键恢复物品至满耐久
- **物品分解**：将可合成物品还原为原材料，支持堆叠物品按数量收费
- **附魔强化**：随机提升一个附魔等级，成功率可配置（默认 60%）
- **附魔重铸**：清除所有附魔，生成 1~3 个互不冲突的新附魔

## 使用方法

潜行 + 右键点击铁砧打开重铸界面。

## 经济系统

- **金币模式**：需要 Vault 经济插件
- **经验模式**：无需额外插件，开箱即用

每个功能在 `config.yml` 中都有独立的费用配置。

## 权限

- `reforge.reload` – 允许使用 `/reforgereload` 重载配置（默认 OP）

## 多语言

内置中文和英文语言包。在 `config.yml` 中切换语言，或创建自己的语言文件！

## 兼容性

兼容 Paper、Spigot、Purpur、Bukkit 服务端，支持 Minecraft 1.13 ~ 1.21+。

---

**祝使用愉快！🎉**
